jobs.title: Business Operations Analyst (Part-time)
jobs.description:
Comcast brings together the best in media and technology. We drive innovation to create the world's best entertainment and online experiences. As a Fortune 50 leader, we set the pace in a variety of innovative and fascinating businesses and create career opportunities across a wide range of locations and disciplines. We are at the forefront of change and move at an amazing pace, thanks to our remarkable people, who bring cutting-edge products and services to life for millions of customers every day. If you share in our passion for teamwork, our vision to revolutionize industries and our goal to lead the future in media and technology, we want you to fast-forward your career at Comcast.

Job Summary
The Business Operations Analyst supports the day-to-day operations of Comcast Netherlands / Metrological, providing local coordination across vendors, business teams and centralized Comcast functions. Reporting to the Managing Director, this role drives operational issues through resolution, supports vendor and contractor processes, and helps ensure effective execution of global Comcast processes within the local organization.
This role is offered on a part-time basis (4 days per week).
Job Description
Key Responsibilities:

Vendor & Supplier Operations
- Act as operational point of contact for key vendors and suppliers, supporting onboarding, ongoing administration and vendor relationships.

- Coordinate vendor requirements across Comcast systems and functions, including Finance, Procurement, Security and Privacy.

- Proactively manage vendor issues and operational blockers through resolution.

Finance Operations Coordination
- Serve as the local interface with the US Finance team for vendor onboarding, invoice and payment-related activities.

- Monitor and resolve payment exceptions, working with Finance and suppliers to prevent late payments, collections or service disruption.

- Identify recurring issues and support improvements to vendor and invoice processes.

Contractor & Agency Operations
- Coordinate operational relationships with contracting agencies, including onboarding/offboarding, SOWs, renewals and required approvals.

- Work with business owners, Procurement, Legal and external agencies to ensure contracting processes are completed on time.

- Coordinate recurring contractor administration and resolve operational issues impacting delivery.

Compliance & Corporate Processes
- Coordinate vendor-related corporate processes, including security, privacy and procurement assessments and requirements.

- Act as the operational interface between vendors, local stakeholders and relevant Comcast teams.

- Track required actions and documentation through completion.

Business Operations & Process Improvement
- Coordinate cross-functional operational activities and resolve issues that fall between local and centralized teams.

- Identify process gaps and opportunities to improve operational efficiency and continuity.

- Maintain appropriate tracking and reporting of operational issues, actions and dependencies.

Qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Business Management, Operations or related field, or equivalent experience.

- Experience in business operations, business analysis, vendor management or a related role is preferred.

- Strong organizational, analytical and problem-solving skills with demonstrated ability to drive issues through resolution.

- Excellent communication skills and ability to work effectively with internal and external stakeholders across functions and geographies.

- Experience with vendor, Finance/AP, Procurement or contractor processes preferred.

- Fluency in both written and spoken English and Dutch is required.

jobs.title: Demand Sales Manager - Comcast Advertising
jobs.description:
FreeWheel, a Comcast company, provides comprehensive ad platforms for publishers, advertisers, and media buyers. Powered by premium video content, robust data, and advanced technology, we’re making it easier for buyers and sellers to transact across all screens, data types, and sales channels. As a global company, we have offices in nine countries and can insert advertisements around the world.

Job Summary
Responsible for prospecting, selling, developing and expanding the client base for Advanced Media. Drives new and incremental revenue and regularly meets pre-established activity and results quotas. Works directly with high-profile or strategically important customers. Monitors and evaluates competitive media spending for sales categories. Has in-depth experience, knowledge and skills in advertising and Connected Television Advertising. Understand the premium online video industry and the challenges facing a typical marketer or agency.
Job Description
Core Responsibilities
- Book of business – Own and grow an assigned portfolio of agencies (within a holding group) and/or advertisers; deliver quarterly and annual revenue targets.

- Strong field presence – Spend most of your time with clients: regular face-to-face meetings with traders, planners, programmatic teams, investment directors and advertiser marketing teams; run workshops, trainings and client events.

- Account planning – Map each account (decision-makers, buying processes, budgets, competitors), build an account plan and lead the annual negotiation and partnership discussions with your agencies and advertisers.

- New business – Proactively prospect new advertisers and agency teams, and go beyond the agency to engage brands directly with tailored proposals.

- Proposals & briefs – Answer RFPs and briefs with customised proposals, working with sales planning, programmatic, ad operations, marketing and insights teams.

- Programmatic & deal execution – Set up and follow PMP / programmatic guaranteed / IO deals with agency trading desks and DSPs; anticipate and resolve delivery issues with internal teams.

- Maintains up-to-date customer and prospect records as instructed and participates in development of sales forecasts.

- Weekly reporting – Deliver a reliable weekly forecast and contribute to weekly reporting to the French and international leadership.

- Completes required documentation and reporting for the proper processing of contracts, advertising schedules and call expense reports.

- Market intelligence – Share feedback on the market, competitors and client needs to shape our products, pricing and partnerships.

- International collaboration – Work with colleagues across markets and agency pods on cross-border and multi-market opportunities.

- Sales travel within France and Europe when needed.

- Consistent exercise of independent judgment and discretion in matters of significance.

Required Skills & Experience
- More than 5 years of media sales experience in an ad sales house (régie), publisher, ad tech or video platform – ideally in TV, CTV or online video. Agency-side trading/investment profiles with a strong commercial appetite will also be considered.

- Proven track record of owning a book of business and consistently meeting or exceeding revenue targets.

- An established network within at least one major holding group (Publicis Media, Havas Media Network, Omnicom Media, WPP Media, Dentsu) and/or with advertiser marketing and media teams in France.

- A field-driven, hands-on approach: comfortable building relationships from trader to C-level, and running a high, consistent level of client meetings.

- Solid understanding of the French media buying ecosystem: annual negotiations, the Sapin law framework, TV and digital video buying, CTV.

- Good knowledge of the programmatic ecosystem: DSPs, SSPs, ad serving, PMP and programmatic guaranteed deals.

- Strong organisation and CRM discipline; able to manage a pipeline and forecast accurately.

- Excellent presentation, negotiation and storytelling skills.

- Fluent French and professional English (internal reporting and international meetings are in English).

- Own the customer experience think and act in ways that put our customers first, give them seamless digital options at every touchpoint, and make them promoters of our products and services.

Job Summary
We are seeking a Senior Strategic Partnerships Manager to lead supply-side technology partners within the Technology Partnerships group. This role combines partner management, cross-functional leadership, and technical program oversight to deliver scalable solutions in support of some of the biggest streaming content owners globally, while improving existing revenue streams and helping to scope new ones.

You will act as the primary point of contact for strategic partners, quarterback internal collaboration across Product, Client Services, and Revenue teams, by owning certification programs for APIs and running partner management for our Walled Garden integrations e.g. YouTube. Additionally, you will identify growth opportunities, negotiate mission-critical deals, and operationalize partner feedback into roadmap priorities. - Represent the company in partner-facing discussions, providing guidance on product capabilities, certification requirements, and adoption strategies.
- Lead Cross-Organizational Collaboration: Problem solve and function as the “quarterback” for initiatives requiring coordination between Global Client Services (GCS), Product, and Revenue teams.
- Build and maintain strong partner relationships to align priorities with revenue objectives, unlock mutual business value, and lead joint planning to accelerate monetization initiatives.
- Identify opportunities to drive growth through partnerships by collaborating internally with product, sales, and marketing teams.
- Collect, give structure to, operationalize partner feedback to inform product strategy and improve revenue and client retention.
- Establish and manage technical integration agreements with third‑party ad servers to broaden the FreeWheel SSP supply footprint
- Leverage certification programs (APIs, transcoding, ad workflows) as a strategic differentiator to attract, retain, and grow partner relationships.
- Negotiate favorable long-term agreements with new and existing partners in collaboration with legal, finance, and product teams.
- Enable global commercial teams to grow revenue by bringing partnerships to market with supporting data and materials.

Required Qualifications
- 7+ years in ad tech roles at DSP, SSP, publisher, or agency. Similar experience in technology consulting is acceptable.
- Hands-on experience with API integrations (REST/OAuth/JSON), certification workflows, and partner QA/sign-off.
- Strong knowledge of CTV fundamental protocols: ORTB, VAST, and SSAI
- Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives, balance technical and business implications of integrations, and negotiate complex deals.
- Experience negotiating partner agreements
- Strong commercial mindset and data acumen: Proven ability to define revenue-focused KPIs, develop executive dashboards, and analyze performance trends using BI tools
- Familiarity with privacy and ad standards (CCPA/CPRA, GDPR basics, COPPA, MRC/TAG/IVT).

- Experience with FreeWheel ecosystem (Video Player Integrations, Marketplace, Programmatic Module).

jobs.description:
Comcast Business offers a suite of Connectivity, Communications, Networking, Cybersecurity, Wireless, and Managed Solutions to help global organizations of all sizes prepare for what’s next. Powered by the nation’s largest Gig-speed broadband network and backed by 24/7 customer support, Comcast Business is the nation’s largest technology provider to small businesses and one of the leading service providers to the Enterprise market. jobs.description:
Comcast Spectacor is a leading sports and entertainment company with a diverse portfolio including the National Hockey League’s Philadelphia Flyers, the award-winning Xfinity Mobile Arena, and the worldclass esports franchise, T1 Entertainment & Sports. Headquartered in Philadelphia, Comcast Spectacor has more than 50 years of experience, with a proven track record of cultivating championship teams, managing worldclass venues, and promoting vibrant communities. Comcast Spectacor is part of Comcast Corporation, a global media and technology company that operates Comcast Cable, NBCUniversal, and Sky.

Job Summary
The Human Resources Department of Comcast Spectacor is seeking an experienced HR Manager to serve as a strategic HR Business Partner to a diverse group of internal clients, including event-based and unionized workforces. This role is responsible for aligning HR strategies with business objectives, driving team performance, and ensuring a high standard of professionalism across all employee interactions.
The HR Manager will oversee key human resources functions including recruitment, labor relations, compliance, benefits, compensation, and employee relations to maximize organizational effectiveness. This position requires a strong leader who can build trusted relationships quickly, navigate complex labor environments and support employees in fast-paced, event-driven operations.
Job Description
Responsibilities:
- Serve as a trusted HR Business Partner, providing strategic guidance to leaders who manage part-time employees on the consistent application of HR policies, procedures and effective performance management practices.
- Build strong partnerships with union representatives; interpret and administer collective bargaining agreements (CBAs), manage grievance processes, and support contract negotiations as needed.
- Provide HR support for event-based employees, including workforce planning, on-site issue resolution, and ensuring a positive employee experience during events and peak operations.
- Administer and ensure compliance with federal, state, and local employment laws, as well as company policies and labor contracts.
- Oversee and manage complex employee relations matters, conducting thorough investigations and providing sound, professional recommendations.
- Partner with Payroll to troubleshoot pay-related issues, ensuring timely and accurate resolution for employees, including event staff and union workers.
- Lead part time employee engagement initiatives, including planning, execution, and analysis of the annual employee survey and action planning.
- Manage full-cycle onboarding and offboarding processes for part-time employees, ensuring a seamless and professional experience.
- Exercise a high level of independent judgment, discretion, and professionalism in handling confidential and sensitive matters.
- Regular, consistent and punctual attendance. Must be able to work nights and weekends, variable schedule(s) as necessary.
- Other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Qualifications
- 5–7 years of progressive Human Resources experience, preferably in a fast-paced, event-driven or hospitality environment.
- Demonstrated leadership and management experience, including developing and leading teams.
- Experience working in a unionized environment, with working knowledge of collective bargaining agreements and labor relations practices strongly preferred.
- Experience supporting hourly, seasonal, or event-based employees.
- Strong interpersonal, conflict resolution, and employee relations skills.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with a high level of professionalism and executive presence.
- Thorough knowledge of federal, state, and local employment laws and regulations.
